The advisory is a stack-exhaustion DoS from compiling attacker-supplied, deeply-nested glob patterns, which no build script here feeds it. 3.0.3 is the latest npm version and the only version in the advisory's affected range (<= 3.0.3), and GHSA reports no patched version, so there is no in-range fix to take; track upstream and remove this exception when a fix is published (2026-10-03).

The DoS needs a caller-supplied format string carrying an unbounded precision specifier, and neither route to sprintf-js supplies one: backend-errors' only call site (formatMessage) has zero callers repo-wide (verified 2026-10-07), and the @loglayer/transport-simple-pretty-terminal use formats with library-internal constant patterns. 1.1.3 is the latest published version and sits inside the advisory's range (<= 1.1.3), and bun audit reports no published fix, so there is no in-range upgrade to take; track upstream and remove this exception when a fix is published (2026-10-07).
